plainSummary: Newly approved spec revisions remain authoritative, and changing a live document hash cannot conceal drift.
summary: Bounded 520ff720-fc13-8275-b710-f677f8d2efb4 review of revision-scoped document amendments and snapshot-backed document digest validation. Breaker-owned initial regression tests ran red before production changes: node --test packages/ledger/dist/workstream/pr1-regressions.break.test.js exited 1, 0 passed / 4 failed for the intended assertions. After production fix, compiled with node packages/ledger/node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p packages/ledger/tsconfig.json (exit 0) and ran node --test packages/ledger/dist/workstream/doc-digest.test.js packages/ledger/dist/workstream/doc-digest.break.test.js packages/ledger/dist/workstream/pr1-regressions.break.test.js (exit 0): 18 tests passed, 0 failed. The four original killers were not weakened. One additional composition probe verifies a legitimate amendment after reseal still succeeds and cannot mask mutation of the underlying seal pointer.
killersCited: packages/ledger/src/workstream/pr1-regressions.break.test.ts::resealing an amended document accepts the newly sealed bytes
packages/ledger/src/workstream/pr1-regressions.break.test.ts::reverting to a prior revision amendment fails both seal check and audit
packages/ledger/src/workstream/pr1-regressions.break.test.ts::check-seal rejects rewriting only the live document digest
packages/ledger/src/workstream/pr1-regressions.break.test.ts::audit rejects rewriting only the live document digest
packages/ledger/src/workstream/pr1-regressions.break.test.ts::a current amendment works after resealing but cannot hide a corrupted seal pointer
packages/ledger/src/workstream/doc-digest.break.test.ts::out-of-intent: empty afterDocDigest on latest amend must not fall back past prior amend
residualRisks: Scope is the two document-seal regressions and neighboring seal/backfill/amend checks; release packaging and CI changes require their separate review.
Snapshot validation detects divergence from the committed snapshot; it does not authenticate a principal or protect against simultaneous rewriting of both live records and snapshot history.
Breaker owned regression tests and this review only; production changes were independently owned by the builder.
